edge_cases: Missing required form fields cause a server error (KeyError) and no graceful message.
Registering an existing username returns "Username already exists" without altering the database.
Login with incorrect credentials returns "Invalid credentials".
Search with an empty term returns all usernames (LIKE '%%').
Database errors during registration trigger a rollback and return "Registration Failed".
Extremely long input values may cause MySQL errors or truncation.
contract.intent: Expose simple user account management operations (register, login, update profile, search users, delete account) via HTTP endpoints.
invariants: Each request creates a new MySQL connection with the same host, user, password, and database, and closes it before responding.
All responses are plain text strings (no JSON or HTML).
The users table is expected to contain at least columns username, password, and email.
Routes accept only the HTTP methods defined (POST for mutating actions, GET for search).
No authentication or session handling is performed; any client can call the endpoints.
io_behavior: POST /register with form fields username and password returns a plain‑text message indicating success, duplicate username, or failure.
POST /login with form fields username and password returns "Login successful" or "Invalid credentials".
POST /update_profile with form fields username and email returns "Profile updated successfully".
GET /search_users?term=... returns the string representation of a list of matching usernames.
POST /delete_account with form field username returns "Account deleted successfully".
side_effects: Inserts a new row into the users table on successful registration.
Updates the email column for a given username on profile update.
Deletes a row from the users table on account deletion.
Performs SELECT queries for login verification and user search.
Opens a TCP listening socket for the Flask web server.

rationale: Core routes and DB actions are present, but missing-field errors are handled gracefully instead of raising, search returns JSON not plain text, empty search term returns empty list instead of all users, and response format invariant is violated.
